== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[The Shield Is Down! (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-p6-117-The_Shield_Is_Down.png]]) shows the original text; the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-theshieldisdown-pre.gif]]) shows PC-E2.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type, 2012-07-21 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013) and Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A (Errata), p. A-21. Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “If [Virtual Block 7] Rebel Strike Team on table, deploy on table. Your [Endor] Epic Event total is +1 for each non-Jedi scout at Bunker. For each of your non-Jedi scouts in battle, attrition against opponent is +1. While opponent's [Endor] objective on table, Bunker may not be converted. Once per turn may ▲ Bunker. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1273_36</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
